title: The high shelf
goals: Show the book with `reveal` before the spell brings it.
starting_code: # The rare book is somewhere among the books up on the high shelf.
hints: Find the book with `find_nearest`, keep it under a name, and show it with `reveal`.
Walk to stand right beneath it.
Use `cast` to cast *fendra* with the book, then use `pick_up`.
intro: The rare book I have wanted for so long is up there among all the others, and I cannot tell which one it is! But your program can find it.
outro: You have it! The spell worked perfectly.
learned: Now you know that the *fendra* spell is told which thing to bring, and that a thing it brings must still be picked up.
